    "https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Shiftlock-72866" -- LU SENDIRI YANG BIKIN INI ANJING

local function EXECUTE_RAW(url)
    local success, response = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(url)
    end)
    if success then
        local execSuccess, execError = pcall(function()
            loadstring(response)()
        end)
        if not execSuccess then
            warn("[REZA-VOID] Gagal eksekusi: " .. url .. "\nError: " .. execError)
        else
            print("[REZA-VOID] Berhasil eksekusi: " .. url)
        end
    else
        warn("[REZA-VOID] Gagal fetch: " .. url)
    end
end

-- GAS SEMUA TANPA REM

    EXECUTE_RAW(url)
end
